headline: Canada nearly doubled. Alberta and B.C. led the provinces.

events.text: N.W.T. and Nunavut reported separately from here on

events.source: Nunavut Act, S.C. 1993, c. 28 (in force April 1, 1999)

end_card.title: What changed, July 1971 → July 2026

items.text: **Canada** grew from 22.0 million to 41.8 million people.
**Alberta** grew fastest of the provinces, then B.C. (+155%). Yukon: +165%.
**Atlantic Canada's share** of the population fell. Newfoundland and Labrador grew least (+4%).

end_card.footer: This shows where population changed, not why. Next story: births, deaths, immigration and moves between provinces.

legend.share_title: Share of Canadians · brighter = share rose since 1971

source_note: StatCan Table 17-10-0009-01; July 2026 preliminary. Rounded to 3 significant figures. Spikes sit inside each province, not at its population centre. NT and NU combined before July 1991. Shows where population changed, not why.
